observations: Photo 0: Stacked used car tyres in a storage bay; many tyres piled upright and some lying in front.
Photo 1: More stacks of used tyres; several tyres in the foreground with visible tread patterns and sidewall wear.
Photo 2: Similar tyre stacks; foreground shows a few tyres lying down with visible sidewall markings and tread condition.
